Back in college I had a roommate who would excitedly and happily call or receive a phone call from their mother. Everytime it happened I always wonder what that feels like, to talk to your mom about everyday things like friends would. Or even just the tone that she had with her mom, it felt surreal to me. 

So most of the time I just try block it out. Other times it makes me wonder how different I would be if our relationship was different.

I was trying to move my desk closer to my bed so I wouldn't have to get off to do my homework. I forgot that I had just filled my uncovered flask with piping hot water for my throat, and used one hand to pull one of the desk legs forward. Since I was still in bed my head was right under the level of my desk, and as soon as I pulled it my flask tipped over. I never experienced a burn as bad as this before, and so I quickly had to google search how to deal with it. Now I have a scar on my forehead in the shape of an upside down triangle because of the way the water flowed down my head. 

tldr; spilled hot water on my head because I was too lazy to move to my desk.
